text.en: Common stair riser at most 0.18 m
text.ru: Подъём ступени общей лестницы не более 0.18 м

source.paraphrase: Common stair risers 180 mm maximum, 100 mm minimum.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Common stair tread at least 0.28 m
text.ru: Проступь общей лестницы не менее 0.28 м

source.paraphrase: Common stair tread depth at least 280 mm.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Common stair flight width at least 1.2 m
text.ru: Ширина марша общей лестницы не менее 1.2 м

source.paraphrase: In residential apartment buildings (group R2) the main stair and its landing must be at least 1.2 m clear; the landing may not be narrower than the flight.

text.en: Stair riser in a house at most 0.2 m
text.ru: Подъём ступени в доме не более 0.2 м

source.paraphrase: In villas and inside dwelling units the riser may be up to 200 mm.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Stair tread in a house at least 0.25 m
text.ru: Проступь в доме не менее 0.25 м

source.paraphrase: In villas and inside dwelling units the tread may be as little as 250 mm.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Stair flight width in a house at least 0.9 m
text.ru: Ширина марша в доме не менее 0.9 м

source.paraphrase: In villas (group R3) the main stair and landing need only 0.9 m clear.

text.en: Clear height of habitable rooms at least 2.3 m
text.ru: Высота жилых помещений не менее 2.3 м

source.paraphrase: Habitable spaces and corridors need at least 2.3 m ceiling height; kitchens and baths 2.2 m.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Clear height of work rooms at least 2.3 m
text.ru: Высота рабочих помещений не менее 2.3 м

source.paraphrase: Occupiable spaces including work rooms need at least 2.3 m ceiling height.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Travel distance to an exit or stair at most 61 m (residential)
text.ru: Путь до выхода или лестницы не более 61 м (жилые)

source.paraphrase: Residential travel distance to an exit without sprinklers is about 61 m (76 m with sprinklers).
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ ; table text garbled in extraction, read as 6.1/7.6 with the decimal shifted

text.en: Travel distance to an exit or stair at most 61 m (office)
text.ru: Путь до выхода или лестницы не более 61 м (офисы)

source.paraphrase: Business occupancy without sprinklers about 61 m (about 92 m with sprinklers).
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ ; table text garbled, decimal shifted

text.en: Window area at least 8.0 % of the floor of a habitable room
text.ru: Площадь окон не менее 8.0 % площади пола жилой комнаты

source.paraphrase: Net glazed area for natural light must be at least 8 percent of the floor area of the room.
source.note: read 2026-11-14 in an unofficial hosted copy of the 2007 SBC 201 (official 2018/2024 full text on sbc.gov.sa is paid; only contents pages readable); edition may differ

text.en: Corridor clear width at least 1.1 m

source.paraphrase: A corridor is at least 1.1 m wide.
source.note: read 2026-11-15 in a copy of the 2007 SBC 201 edition; the 2024 edition was not opened, so the number stays unverified

rules.note: na: the code limits riser and tread separately (sa.riser, sa.tread); no stride formula
na: office area enters as occupant load per person for egress, not a minimum room area

text.en: No minimum office area per workplace.
text.ru: Нет минимальной площади на рабочее место.
